name: wayfare
description: Open-source personal travel agent: one ChatGPT Site per trip from your Gmail bookings, with alerts, weather, live flight status and travel tips. Never books or pays.

interface.shortDescription: Trip pages from your Gmail bookings, with alerts, weather and tips
interface.longDescription: Wayfare reads travel confirmations from your Gmail and gives each trip its own ChatGPT Site: day by day with weather, alerts for unbooked nights, tight connections, schedule changes and live delays, a Good to know tab (what to pack, local tips, getting around), a shared to-do list and a calendar file. It checks every morning and on new booking emails. It never books or pays.
defaultPrompt: Set up Wayfare for my trips
Check my inbox for new trips
What do I need to pack?
